stowArmSignFlip.springVerdict: 1.5 N m is enough statically (1.44 N m resting on the stop empty, 1.98 N m with the article; reversed-gravity margin 1.56 / 1.02 N m) and holds the unpowered station impact and a 2 g / 50 ms opening peer contact. It is NOT enough for a >= 3 g / 50 ms opening contact or the front bumper strike, and a 3 N m spring still loses at 5 g. Without the spring the unpowered pan is lost in every case, including power lost only after the article is seated (route braking opens it).
stowArmSignFlip.openingHoldThreshold: between 2 g and 3 g for 50 ms (delta-v 0.98-1.47 m/s) with the 1.5 N m spring; the 2 g case opens 0.25 rad (14.3 deg) and settles back on the stop 0.42 s after the peak

driveFault.conclusion: Rigid (no clutch) gearbox peak: 25.8 N m at 0 ms, 25.9 N m at 1.5 ms, 41.0 N m at 5 ms (F3); F2 37.0 N m at 5 ms; F1 14.3 N m at any latency (before the cut); B1 18.1 N m. 5 ms exceeds REV's 40 N m published failure. Rotor inertia x2 at 5 ms gives 62.9 N m. A friction clutch caps the output stage at its slip torque in every case (16.5/18/21.6 N m modeled, rotor 3e-6 and 9e-6). Setting to stay under 26 N m: 15.4-21.7 N m (above the 15.43 N m normal-duty stall cap, breakaway x1.2 <= 26 N m); the package 16.5-18 N m is inside.

findings: All 12 cases pass at 30 A and unpowered for both stiffnesses (custody, resets, >= 9.75 V branch). Support vs 1.828 mm: 6000 N m/rad 30 A +7.2 um, 5420 30 A +1.9 um; unpowered -3.2 um (5420) and -1.3 um (6000). Peak pan current 19.7 A.
The inhibit never acts in any of the replays (directional; the pan is driven closed whenever it is below -3.5 deg).
Stow arm sign flip makes the closing spring mandatory for unpowered holding; with it the stow holds station impact and 2 g peer contact but not >= 3 g opening contact.
limits: Reflected rotor inertia and slip-clutch breakaway tolerance are assumptions.
Peer contact modeled as a rigid-chassis acceleration pulse; real bumper force histories not measured.
Static checks are level-chassis; route accelerations are only in the replays.
pluginFriction: PR #130 resolved the zero-free-travel and preload gaps; the reviewer still cannot take a chassis-acceleration (peer contact) case or a drive-inhibit/clutch fault.
